# PartyHooks

> Free party hook generator — enter your occasion, get 3 AI-generated TikTok hooks for your party reel. Made for guests, not creators.

PartyHooks is for people attending an event (not professional content creators) who want a fun, on-theme TikTok reel opening line for a wedding, birthday, bachelorette party, or graduation. Enter the occasion and get 3 AI-generated hooks instantly, free, no sign-up.

## Pages

- [Home](https://partyhooks.com/): The hook generator tool, plus an FAQ on how it works.
